name: Open-Meteo Brazil Minas Gerais Historical Precipitation
description: 10 years of daily precipitation sum data for Minas Gerais, Brazil (primary coffee production basin) for agricultural drought modeling and commodity futures backtesting.

etl.script: SELECT CAST(UNNEST(daily.time) AS TIMESTAMP) AS time, CAST(UNNEST(daily.precipitation_sum) AS FLOAT) AS precipitation_sum FROM read_json_auto('https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=-18.5122&longitude=-44.5550&start_date=2014-01-01&end_date=2024-01-01&daily=precipitation_sum&timezone=America%2FSao_Paulo');
